card.name: Digits in phone numbers and ZIP codes
card.fires_on: Digits or closing parenthesis inside US phone area codes and postal codes, such as 415 or New York and Washington ZIP codes, right after a city address or the area code.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: The closing parenthesis or first digits after an area code like (415).

modes.label: ZIP codes
modes.description: Digits inside a five-digit ZIP or postal code after a city and state.

card.plain: It fires on the numbers in phone area codes and ZIP codes inside addresses and contact details.
